description: Read sample rate, channels, bit depth, total samples, and duration from a FLAC file's STREAMINFO metadata block, plus Vorbis comment tags (ARTIST, TITLE, ALBUM, DATE, GENRE, TRACKNUMBER) from its VORBIS_COMMENT block if present. No audio decoding library required.

flac_base64.description: Base64-encoded FLAC file bytes, optionally prefixed with a data: URL scheme

name: read_flac_info
